props.content: Know the true health of your business.

content.text: A focused diagnostic for established founders. Get an objective view across four dimensions and identify the priority that deserves attention next.
Most businesses do not fail from a lack of effort. They lose momentum when the real constraint stays hidden.
A focused diagnostic turns complex signals into a clear view of what matters and where to act.
This is not about vanity metrics. It is about building a business that performs with more intention.
Your ability to acquire, retain, and expand profitable demand.
Efficiency, margins, and the quality of your economic engine.
How well the business manages risk, adapts, and withstands disruption.
Clarity, culture, and execution around what matters most.
Go beyond a score. Use the example report structure to show how a linked quiz can turn responses into a clear outcome and practical recommendations.
Example outcome: strong foundations with the clearest opportunity in profitability.
